paper_title: Unifying inflation with the axion, dark matter, baryogenesis and the seesaw mechanism
coupling_convention: f_a in GeV (x-axis), m_a in eV (y-axis)
notes: This is a theoretical model paper (SMASH) that makes predictions for axion dark matter, not an experimental exclusion limit. The paper predicts an axion mass window of 50–200 μeV (equation 5) corresponding to an axion decay constant (Peccei-Quinn scale) of 3×10^10 to 1.2×10^11 GeV (equation 4). The paper states these are predictions that 'will be probed decisively by the next generation of cosmic microwave background and axion dark matter experiments' such as MADMAX and ORPHEUS. The data points encode the predicted allowed region on the (f_a, m_a) plane: lower bound at f_a=3×10^10 GeV, m_a=50 μeV=5×10^-8 eV; upper bound at f_a=1.2×10^11 GeV, m_a=200 μeV=2×10^-7 eV. This is a projection/prediction, not a measured exclusion limit from an experiment. The coupling_type AxionMass is appropriate because the paper's primary result on dark matter is the predicted (f_a, m_a) window itself, derived from cosmological and particle physics constraints within the SMASH framework. | Auto-corrected couplings: ×1e-16 (×1.00e-16, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=3.2e-05)|)
